query: The Predictive Sample Reuse Method with Applications

record.title: The Predictive Sample Reuse Method with Applications
record.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
record.abstract: An account is given of a recently devised method of prediction based on sample reuse techniques. It is most useful in low structure data paradigms that involve minimal assumptions. A series of applications demonstrating the technique is presented.

journal.name: Journal of the American Statistical Association
